info.title: NotionV2
info.description: Access Notion workspaces to create and update pages, query databases, manage content blocks, search across pages, and monitor databases for new or updated items.

post.description: Creates a new page in a Notion database or as a child of an existing page.

parent_type.description: Whether the parent is a database or a page.

parent_id.description: The ID of the parent database or page.

title.description: The title of the new page.

properties.description: Additional page properties matching the parent database schema (JSON object).

markdown.description: Page content in Notion-flavored Markdown. Mutually exclusive with children.

children.description: Array of block objects for page content (max 100). Mutually exclusive with markdown.

icon_emoji.description: Emoji character for the page icon (e.g. 📝).

cover_url.description: External URL for the page cover image.

get.description: Retrieves the properties of a Notion page by its ID. Does not return page content.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: The ID of the page to retrieve.

patch.description: Updates the properties, icon, cover, or archived status of a Notion page.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: The ID of the page to update.

properties.description: Properties to update (JSON object matching database schema).

archived.description: Set to true to archive the page, false to unarchive.

icon_emoji.description: Emoji character for the page icon. Set to null to remove.

cover_url.description: External URL for the page cover image. Set to null to remove.

post.description: Queries pages in a Notion database with optional filters and sorts. Returns a paginated list of matching pages.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: The ID of the database to query.

filter.description: Filter conditions as a JSON object. Example: {"property": "Status", "select": {"equals": "Done"}}.

start_cursor.description: Cursor for pagination from a previous response.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 100, default 100).

200.description: A paginated list of page objects.

get.description: Retrieves the schema and metadata of a Notion database, including its property definitions.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: The ID of the database to retrieve.

patch.description: Appends new content blocks as children of a specified page or block.

parameters.name: block_id
parameters.description: The ID of the page or block to append children to.

children.description: Array of block objects to append (max 100).

200.description: The list of appended block objects.

get.description: Retrieves the content blocks of a page or block. Returns only first-level children.

parameters.name: block_id
parameters.description: The ID of the page or block to get children of.

parameters.name: start_cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination from a previous response.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of results per page (max 100, default 100).

200.description: A list of child block objects.

post.description: Searches all pages and databases shared with the integration. Can filter by object type and sort by last edited time.

query.description: Search term to match against page and database titles. Leave empty to return all.

value.description: Filter results to only pages or only databases.

direction.description: Sort direction for results by last edited time.

sort.description: Sort results by last edited time.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (max 100, default 100).

200.description: A list of matching page and database objects.

post.summary: When a database item is created
post.description: Triggers when a new item (page) is added to a specified Notion database.
post.x-ms-trigger-hint: Triggers when a new item is added to the specified Notion database.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: The ID of the Notion database to monitor for new items.

200.description: A paginated list of new page objects.

post.summary: When a database item is updated
post.description: Triggers when an existing item (page) is modified in a specified Notion database.
post.x-ms-trigger-hint: Triggers when an item is updated in the specified Notion database.

parameters.name: database_id
parameters.description: The ID of the Notion database to monitor for updated items.

sorts.description: Sort by last edited time descending.

200.description: A paginated list of updated page objects.

post.description: Creates a comment on a Notion page or replies to an existing discussion thread.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to comment on.

discussion_id.description: The ID of an existing discussion thread to reply to.

type.description: The type of rich text object.

content.description: The text content of the comment.

rich_text.description: The comment content as rich text array.

get.description: Retrieves unresolved comments from a Notion page or block.

parameters.name: block_id
parameters.description: The ID of the page or block to retrieve comments for.

get.description: Retrieves all users in the Notion workspace. Does not include guests.
Retrieves a specific Notion user by their ID.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: The ID of the user to retrieve.

delete.description: Moves a block to trash (soft delete). The block can be restored.

parameters.name: block_id
parameters.description: The ID of the block to delete (move to trash).

last_edited_time.description: When the page was last edited.

emoji.description: Emoji character if icon type is emoji.

last_edited_time.description: When the page was last edited.

last_edited_by.description: User who last edited the page.

in_trash.description: Whether the page is in trash.

results.description: Array of page objects matching the query.

has_more.description: True if more results exist beyond this page.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results.

title.description: Database title as rich text array.

description.description: Database description as rich text array.

last_edited_time.description: When the database was last edited.

properties.description: Database property schema (column definitions with types).

is_inline.description: Whether the database is inline within a page.

type.description: The type of the block (paragraph, heading_1, etc).

has_children.description: Whether the block has nested children.

last_edited_time.description: When the block was last edited.
When the object was last edited.

results.description: Array of matching page and database objects.
